@@ -48,6 +357,7 @@ The following bugs have been fixed:
 // Bugs with the {notable} attribute show up in the "What's Changed" box on the download page.
 //* Wireshark contains traces of nuts. What kind of nuts? The kind you're allergic to. wsbuglink:5000[] {notable}
 
+* Fuzz job crash: randpkt-2026-05-22-14496207576.pcap. wsbuglink:21266[].
 * Wireshark Version 4.6.6 - File Capture Properties is excessively slow and hangs Wireshark on Windows. wsbuglink:21337[].
 * TCP Preference 'Analyze TCP sequence numbers' SEGFAULTs when toggled. wsbuglink:21380[].
 * Wireshark misdecodes S-NSSAI location validity information IE (5G NAS) wsbuglink:21411[].
@@ -57,10 +367,17 @@ The following bugs have been fixed:
 * Wireshark misdecodes Registration wait range IE (5G NAS) wsbuglink:21432[].
 * Wireshark misdecodes Extended CAG information IE (5G NAS) wsbuglink:21433[].
 * Stack buffer overflow in K12/RF5 writer. wsbuglink:21436[].
+* Security issues fixed in 4.6.8 and 4.4.18 Tracker. wsbuglink:21437[].
 * BLF writer out-of-bounds read on truncated VLAN-tagged Ethernet frames. wsbuglink:21441[].
 * DLMS/COSEM compact-array TypeDescription recursion bypass can exhaust the stack. wsbuglink:21442[].
+* packet-knxip: Secure Wrapper size-offset causes NULL deref / SEGV when decrypting. wsbuglink:21444[].
+* wiretap/rtpdump: swapped caplen/len on truncated samples. wsbuglink:21445[].
+* H.245 returnedFunction nested GenericMessage dereferences NULL packet state. wsbuglink:21447[].
+* X.509 export-object tap dereferences missing certificate subject. wsbuglink:21448[].
+* Sniffer REC_HEADER2 error path over-reads stack buffer. wsbuglink:21461[].
 * Deep NetLog JSON nesting exhausts the native stack. wsbuglink:21462[].
 * androiddump signed btsnoop length causes global out-of-bounds read. wsbuglink:21464[].
+* ERF writer underflows payload length for tiny truncated packets. wsbuglink:21466[].
 * Wireshark misdecodes SOR transparent container IE (5G NAS) wsbuglink:21472[].
 * Unbounded Daintree timestamp fraction causes signed integer overflow. wsbuglink:21473[].
 * Wireshark misdecodes SOR-CMCI of SOR transparent container IE (5G NAS) wsbuglink:21477[].
